title: Running Injury Prevention
subtitle: Evidence, mechanisms, practical application, progression, and safety considerations for running injury prevention
reading_level: Intermediate - general audience with interest in exercise science
evidence_strength: Moderate to Strong Evidence supporting gradual training progression, strength training, and biomechanical interventions. review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
